prefix: Square character thumbnail, portrait of a
style_direction: Art Style: polished anime visual-novel key art in a distinct early-to-mid-2000s Key visual novel aesthetic associated with Jun Maeda-era works such as 'Clannad' and 'Little Busters!', clean delicate line art, soft cel-shading, luminous pastel coloring, large detailed expressive eyes, simple nose and mouth.
framing: Use a consistent waist-up portrait crop from the head through slightly below the waist or belt line, matching the established Celine and Juniper portraits. Keep the waist landmark and a small section of the garment below it visible. Expand only when a specified gesture requires additional room, and keep all required hands fully inside the canvas.
background_constraints: Background: a solid two-color gradient that bleeds off every edge of the canvas; zero padding, borders, margins, or frames; artwork must touch all four edges.
identity_constraints: Keep the character's identity, clothing, color palette, and distinctive features unchanged.
negative_constraints: Single character only. No text, logos, signatures, or watermarks. Natural anatomy with no extra, fused, or duplicated visible limbs or fingers.
